items: 1 × 15 oz can black beans, rinsed and drained

steps.title: Cook the aromatics
steps.body: In a nonstick skillet, cook over medium heat until you can smell it (about 2–3 minutes): **2 Tbsp olive oil**, **2 tsp minced garlic** and **1 tsp ground cumin**.

steps.title: Add the beans
steps.body: Add **1 × 15 oz can black beans**, rinsed and drained, **1 cup tomato juice** and **1½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Heat through
steps.body: Continually stir until heated through. Just before serving, stir in **2 Tbsp fresh chopped cilantro**.
